name: resistance band 45 degree hip extension glute focused
description: A hip extension on a 45 degree bench with a band added for extra glute load. It builds the glutes and the back of the thighs.
instructions: Set up on a 45 degree hip extension bench with the band anchored under your feet and held across your upper back.
Cross your arms or hold the band at your shoulders.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to come back up.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
Do not over-arch your lower back at the top.
